name: Peer View
author: beomsu
description: Read-only spectate mode for multiplayer combat. Click an ally's character and the whole screen follows them: their hand in place of yours, and their energy, stars, HP, gold, deck count, potions, relics and portrait in the top bar. Their pile and deck screens open from the usual buttons and hotkeys, and any card-selection screen they hit is mirrored on your side, read-only. UI-only: no game state is touched, peers do not need the mod installed.
